title: IVG Smart Max Frozen Watermelon Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Frozen Watermelon offers a clean and refreshing blend of juicy Watermelon and cool Menthol. The fruit note is light and sweet with a sun-ripened quality, while the chilled finish adds a crisp edge that keeps the flavour bright and smooth. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the refill chamber automatically supplies e-liquid to the pod, potentially delivering up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on how you vape. No refilling or coil changes needed. With mesh coil technology and a reliable MTL draw, this pod is designed exclusively for use with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
